strategies.name: vwap_session_reversion_and_support_resistance
strategies.entry_summary: Use the session VWAP as an institutional dynamic reference and look for trades when price reaches, tests, or reclaims it within the session. variants.variant_label: Long continuation after VWAP reclaim / retest
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to break and retest VWAP after being below fair value
variants.target_note: use upper standard deviations as targets or trail toward session rebalancing
variants.transcript_quote: after we broke it and tested it we can try our long trade

variants.variant_label: Short continuation after VWAP loss / resistance
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: look for price above fair value failing back under VWAP or testing VWAP as resistance
variants.target_note: use lower standard deviations as targets or trail toward session rebalancing
variants.transcript_quote: same if the position is short they will try to load most of the volume in the premium area

result.enumeration_note: One VWAP-based strategy is taught; long/short usage around the same VWAP framework are opposite directional applications of the same session-reference skeleton, so they are represented as variants within one strategy.
